challenge.better_approach: Considered keeping the old name as a bus alias (A1) and moving the class path only (B); the orchestrator answered A, no alias, because an alias is a retirement owed and B keeps the two roots disagreeing.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That every box's instance-space for this device can move by a recipe its holder runs, and that no consumer pins the old pg table name outside the code grep covers.
challenge.prior_art: Ticket 38125c3ada38 (launchers/ moved to recovery + cc) is the in-house move; its three misses (memory a-path-rename-has-three-spellings) shape the census: slash, path-joined, ticket records, and never a regex into ~/.cairn.
challenge.real_collision: None exclusive: batch11 on Linux crosses d97e inside inference_domain, so the build is held until the orchestrator releases it; a sequencing fact, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: Done: no live code names inference_domain, the device answers the bus as inferenceproxy, its proofs are green at the new address, and the recipe's verify is green on the home box after one apply and unchanged after a second. Wrong intent: the outline's 11.4 address turns out to name only the class path.
answers.from_idea: none, because the move was named by the answer to question open-fc9a70eb49cf (CairnCommons/questions/open-fc9a70eb49cf.json): outline 11.4 names the device's address cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/ while it stands at cairn/devices/inference_domain/
answers.how: git mv the device folder; rename its identity in code (bus id, tree owner, answers table, log and instance paths) and every importer and path spelling across cairn; ship an idempotent apply/verify recipe beside the device that moves each box's ~/.cairn instance and logs dirs and renames the pg answers table, leaving metric history under its old name; historical records stay as written.
answers.traces_to: Law 5 (the thing and the story of it may live in two roots but never contradict) and CLAUDE.md's one address written in two roots; outline 11.4.
answers.what: The inference proxy device stands at the address outline 11.4 names, cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/, in both roots: class-space code and its instance-space life.

bullets.text: The device name is its live identity in six places (bus id, OWNER, answers table, METRIC_SOURCE, logs, instance overlay), so the rename needs a per-box recipe, not a regex.
